text:
incbot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PROD runtime crashloop (high rate) — priority P1. auto-escalation to #incidents and on-call.

alice.runtime: seeing repeated container restarts on gpu-nodes in us-west-2. crash reason = segfault in fused_tensorrt_kernel.so.

sam.oncall: confirmed. kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep crash | wc -l -> 16 pods crashlooping across 4 nodes.

maria-sre: logs show CUDA illegal memory access + abort. snippet: ```E tensorflow: Cuda failure: illegal memory access
Backtrace (most recent call last):
  runtime::KernelExecutor::execute() at kernel_executor.cc:243
  runtime::Dispatch::run() at dispatch.cc:112
  ...
Signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 1 (SEGV_MAPERR)```

alice.runtime: also seeing vLLM plugin trace referencing kv-cache index out of bounds right before segfault. probaby fused kernel + kv layout.

tim-eng: tagging: @alice.runtime @maria-sre I'm pulling core dumps now: `gdb -c core.* --batch -ex "bt full"` to get stack. will share shortly.

leah-support: CS flag: a few enterprise customers reporting 5xx on generation requests since 03:12 UTC. Support ticket spike +2. Not widespread but high-severity for those tenants.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: "Crashloop / Segfault - Runtime" initiated. Steps: 1) divert traffic 2) cordon nodes 3) collect telemetry 4) hotfix or rollback.

sam.oncall: action plan: divert traffic to fallback variant, cordon affected nodes, restart pods on healthy nodes, escalate to eng-runtime for hotpatch. assigning roles: alice -> runtime triage, tim -> debugging/core analysis, maria -> cluster ops, leah -> customer comms.

alice.runtime: diverting route for model redwood/text-llm-v2-quant-trt -> redwood/text-llm-v2-quant-trt-safe (non-fused kernels) via routing policy change. patching route at edge config now. `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/modify -d '{"route":"text-llm-v2","variant":"quant-trt-safe"}'`

incbot: Routing update: 50% -> safe variant applied (changes deployed to edge in 22s). Watching error rates.

maria-sre: cordoning nodes gpu-usw2-17,gpu-usw2-18,gpu-usw2-19,gpu-usw2-20. `kubectl cordon gpu-usw2-17` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. starting node isolation.

tim-eng: core dump backtrace shows segv at fused_tensorrt_kernel.cc: allocate_shared_workspace() -> null ptr deref when workspace size calculation overflows. hypothesis: an integer overflow for long sequence lengths combined with quantized layout.

alice.runtime: to mitigate, disabling fused kernel flag in runtime config and restarting pods on healthy nodes. config change: `--enable-fused-trt=false`. rolling restart.

leah-support: notifying affected customers: we have 2 tenants with elevated error rates (acct-845 and acct-1292). Draft message ready: "We're investigating increased 5xxs for generation. Traffic is being routed to a safe variant; some requests may have higher latency. We'll update in 30m."

sam.oncall: thermal check: GPU memory usage before crash ~ 13GB/16GB. OOM not primary, it's illegal mem access after kernel call. but memory fragmentation might contribute.

incbot: Autoscaling policy: launched 4 additional nodes as part of emergency capacity. provisioning ETA ~ 4m.

maria-sre: nodes provisioned, starting pod reschedules. after config change and restart, 8/16 crashloops cleared, error rate dropped 70% on safe variant.

tim-eng: uploaded core, dmp, and logs to /tmp/incidents/4067894321/ on s3: s3://redwood-incidents/4067894321/{core,logs,backtraces}.tar.gz. sharing link with eng-runtime.

alice.runtime: temporary mitigation implemented: - disabled fused trt kernel - routed 80% traffic to safe variant - cordoned 4 nodes - restarted runtime pods. still seeing 4 pods crash intermittently on node gpu-usw2-21. investigating memory allocator differences on that host.

leah-support: update sent to customers acct-845 and acct-1292. they acknowledged and asked for ETA. advising "investigation + mitigations in progress, next update 15m".

incbot: PD Note: Incident declared. Severity: P1. Incident lead: sam.oncall. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/crashloop-segfault.

maria-sre: found one node with mismatched driver (nvidia-driver 525 vs expected 535). that node (gpu-usw2-21) has mixed driver + cuda runtime mismatch. patching node driver to 535.

tim-eng: re-run reproducer locally with quantized model and long sequences. repro triggers after ~300 tokens. inserting bounds checks in fused kernel prevents crash locally. will open PR for safety checks but need hotpatch vs full release.

alice.runtime: short-term hotpatch plan: build runtime image with fused kernel disabled by default and extra bounds checks, push to canary pool, run smoke tests. if green -> roll to prod.

sam.oncall: agree. timeline: 1) driver fix on mismatched node (done) 2) hotpatch canary deploy (10m) 3) monitor 30m and decide rollback/merge.

leah-support: customers asking for postmortem and rollback options. prepping FAQ and notifying account reps.

ops-runbook-bot: Checklist progress: Traffic diverted (80%) ✅, Nodes cordoned ✅, Core dumps collected ✅, Hotpatch build in progress ⚙️, Customer comms in progress ✅.

incbot: Alert: error rate trending down to baseline for safe variant. overall 5xx volume reduced to 12% of peak.

tim-eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4823 - Fallback: safe-kernel + bounds checks. CI running.

alice.runtime: canary deployed hotfix to 2 nodes with mixed traffic. initial results: no crashes on canary after 45m of high-load tests.

sam.oncall: handing over to day on-call (maria-sre) at 08:00 UTC. leaving incident as active, monitoring for 2h then postmortem kickoff. @maria-sre you're incident lead going forward.

maria-sre: ack takeover. will run 1hrly updates and coordinate postmortem. please post any lingering artifacts to s3 path above.

leah-support: final note to customers: public status update queued for 08:30 UTC once handover complete.

incbot: Incident status: mitigated (primary vector disabled, routing to safe variant). Next steps: full rollback of fused kernel until full fix lands, postmortem within 72h, root cause analysis: tensorRT fused kernel bounds check + driver mismatch.

sam.oncall: closing immediate pager. if new crashes appear, re-open and alert. thanks team. :tada:
